recommendations.title: Implement Proximity Controls for Pallet Stackers
recommendations.action: Install proximity sensors on pallet stackers to automatically slow down and stop when within 1 m of a worker, and mark pedestrian exclusion zones along stacker routes.
recommendations.rationale: Near misses occurred at t=2.4 s, t=3.9 s, and t=5.4 s, with the stacker within 1 m of a worker in high-severity incidents.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduces the risk of collisions and improves worker safety during forklift safety drills.

recommendations.title: Reassign Idle Workers to Active Tasks
recommendations.action: Assign idle workers to active tasks or stagger break times to reduce idle time, as 66% of people were idle for 75 s on average.
recommendations.rationale: Camera data shows 66% of people idle for 75 s (t=95-170 s), with an average of 6.1 idle workers out of 9.4 people in view.
recommendations.expected_impact: Increases workforce productivity and reduces idle time.

recommendations.title: Redeploy Stationary Machines
recommendations.action: Park or re-dispatch stationary robots to active tasks, as 7.6 machines were in view but only 41% were moving.
recommendations.rationale: Camera data shows 7.6 machines in view on average, with only 41% moving (t=95-185 s), indicating underutilization.
recommendations.expected_impact: Improves machine utilization and reduces idle time.

recommendations.title: Stagger Worker Arrivals in High-Density Zones
recommendations.action: Move standing work out of congested zones and stagger arrivals to reduce peak occupancy, as up to 4.6 people were in one zone for 5 s.
recommendations.rationale: Camera data shows up to 4.6 people in one zone for 5 s (t=65-70 s), indicating congestion.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduces congestion and improves workflow efficiency.

recommendations.title: Repurpose Underused Floor Area
recommendations.action: Use the underused floor area for staging or buffer storage, as it is rarely occupied.
recommendations.rationale: Camera data shows only 0.17 people on average in the underused zone over 300 s, while the camera averages 9.8 people.
recommendations.expected_impact: Optimizes space utilization and improves workflow efficiency.

shift_report_md:
## Summary
The shift experienced high-severity near misses involving pallet stackers and workers, with 66% of people idle for 75 s on average. Machine utilization was low, with only 41% of machines moving. Congestion was observed in high-density zones, and an underused floor area was rarely occupied. Recommendations include implementing proximity controls, reassigning idle workers, redeploying stationary machines, staggering worker arrivals, and repurposing the underused area.

## Safety
- **Near miss: pallet stacker within 1 m of worker** (high, confidence 0.95): w3_run3 ceiling_01, t=2.4 s
- **Near miss: pallet stacker within 1 m of worker** (high, confidence 0.80): w3_run10 ceiling_00, t=5.4 s
- **Near miss: pallet stacker passes close to worker** (medium, confidence 0.80): w3_run7 ceiling_00, t=3.9 s

- Camera_02 zone (near row, column 2): up to 4.2 people at once for 5 s (t=35-40 s).

- Camera_02: 63% of people idle for 100 s (t=115-215 s); on average 7.5 idle of 11.9 people in view.

## Actions
1. **Implement Proximity Controls for Pallet Stackers**: Install proximity sensors on pallet stackers to automatically slow down and stop when within 1 m of a worker, and mark pedestrian exclusion zones along stacker routes.
2. **Reassign Idle Workers to Active Tasks**: Assign idle workers to active tasks or stagger break times to reduce idle time, as 66% of people were idle for 75 s on average.
3. **Redeploy Stationary Machines**: Park or re-dispatch stationary robots to active tasks, as 7.6 machines were in view but only 41% were moving.
4. **Stagger Worker Arrivals in High-Density Zones**: Move standing work out of congested zones and stagger arrivals to reduce peak occupancy, as up to 4.6 people were in one zone for 5 s.
5. **Repurpose Underused Floor Area**: Use the underused floor area for staging or buffer storage, as it is rarely occupied.
